Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: BrightDev webinar — bio + greenroom & interpretation

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for agreeing to join our Nov 24 webinar, "Building with TinyML at Scale". Quick things we need to lock down this week so the producer team can finalize run-of-show: 

- Short bio (75-150 words) and preferred headshot — we’ll use these on the event page and in the host intro.
- Slides: final deck as PPTX (we’ll export to PDF). If you have any embedded fonts or video, flag them now.
- Interpretation: we’re offering simultaneous Spanish and Japanese interpretation. Do you want an interpreter on your audio channel or to rely on captions?
- AV needs: will you be sharing a remote demo (screen share + audio)? Any extra mics or system audio we should provision for?
- Greenroom: two internal options for a brief mic check — Nov 24 at 9:00–9:30 PT or 9:30–10:00 PT (event starts 10:00 PT). Which works?

Attached: Agenda_v4.pdf (current run-of-show draft).

If you can send the bio + headshot by end of day Thursday (Nov 19) and slides by EOD Nov 19 that would be ideal — gives the team time to bake captions and check fonts.

Appreciate it — excited to have you.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Events Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform
From: Emma Langley <emma.langley@brightdev.io>

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 10:14 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Emma,
> 
> Thanks again for agreeing to join our Nov 24 webinar, "Building with TinyML at Scale". Quick things we need to lock down...

Thanks, Soojin — excited to be part of this. Quick answers below and I’ll follow up with attachments: 

Bio (short): Emma Langley is Head of Edge Platforms at BrightDev, where she leads product and developer relations for on-device ML tooling. Emma has 10+ years building SDKs and runtime tooling for constrained hardware and frequently speaks at systems conferences about shipping ML at the edge.

Headshot: attached (emma_langley_headshot.jpg).
Slides: I’ll upload the deck (PPTX) by Nov 19 EOD. It includes a 7-minute live demo; I’ll provide the demo repo link in the notes.
Interpretation: Spanish interpretation would be great on an audio channel — that’s our primary audience. Japanese isn’t necessary for this session.
AV/Demo: I will share system audio and will need screen share + an additional guest mic (I’ll bring a USB lav as backup). We also use a custom font in the slides — prefer we convert to system fonts if possible.
Greenroom: 9:30–10:00 PT works best. If we keep the mic check to 5–7 minutes and then run through demo network access, that should be sufficient.

Thanks — attaching headshot now.

Best,
Emma
